trigger: Searching Marguerite's clinic drawer for antibiotics.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A spiral notebook under the gauze. Names. Dates. Doses. Mrs. Halloran. Mr. Ostrowski. Fourteen.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The last page says IF IT COMES TO IT. The first name on it is Theo Kowalczyk.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: ...You found it. Sit down, my dear. Please. Before you say anything.

choices.text: You were going to kill my son.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Every one of them asked. Every one was dying slow, in a cold house, in pain. You understand?

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Theo's name is there because if his insulin ends, the end is ugly. I wanted him not to suffer.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: I did not want to be the one. I wanted to be ready. Those are different.

choices.text: Cross him off. He's not going to need it.
You don't get to decide that.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She takes the pen and crosses him out. Her hand is very steady.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: ...No one has ever said that to me. I don't know if they should.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: No. I don't. I've only ever been the one in the room when no one else would come.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She closes the notebook. She doesn't ask you to stay.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You put it back under the gauze. You'll carry it now too.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Outside, ash is falling on the clean snow, so there's no clean snow.
